Rethymno to Heraklion Airport, and Heraklion Airport to Rethymno

coverage.statement: Our transfer services are based in Rethymno and operate within the city of Rethymno and the wider Rethymno region. We also provide transfers between Rethymno and Chania Airport, Chania City, Heraklion Airport or Heraklion City, in both directions. Please note that we do not offer transfers that start and end within the Chania region, the Heraklion region, or the Lassithi region, including areas such as Agios Nikolaos.
coverage.note: Airport and city-to-city transfers between Chania or Heraklion and Rethymno are covered in both directions. Journeys that start and end within Chania, Heraklion or Lassithi are not covered.

vehicle.name: Mini Van
vehicle.description: One to eight seats, suited to families and small groups.
vehicle.note: One vehicle is published. Larger wedding parties are covered by combining vehicles rather than by a bigger single vehicle.

pricing.note: The listed airport and city routes have fixed totals per vehicle, per one-way journey, in either direction: €90 for 1-4 passengers and €105 for 5-8 passengers. Each return leg uses the same rate. Per-kilometre rates and minimums apply only to other routes in the Rethymno region. Route priceEur remains null because fixed fares have two passenger bands rather than one price.

extras.label: Child seat
extras.description: Baby car seat for children aged 0-36 months
extras.note: Published at 0.00 EUR in the booking engine, so it is added free of charge, up to two seats per booking.

weddings.positioning: A local transportation and tour operator based in Rethymno, working directly with wedding planners, couples and guest groups.
services: Airport transfers for wedding guests from Heraklion and Chania airports to Rethymno, and back for departures
Hotel-to-venue transport on the wedding day, and the return afterwards
Group transportation across multiple pickup points and staggered departure times
Private tours and excursions for wedding guests during their stay
Customised itineraries built around the wedding schedule
process: Share the wedding date, venue, number of guests, accommodation locations and arrival airports.
Way to Crete works out which transfers are actually required.
Optional guest tours and excursions are arranged around the wedding schedule.
Pickup locations, departure times, routes and vehicles are confirmed against the wedding itinerary.
The plan is fixed in advance so the day itself needs no coordination.
weddings.coverageNote: The same regional limits apply: Rethymno city and region, plus transfers between Rethymno and Chania or Heraklion airports and cities in both directions. Journeys that start and end within Chania, Heraklion or Lassithi are not covered. Please share venue and accommodation locations so we can confirm coverage.
weddings.vehicleNote: Vehicles are matched to group size and route: private cars and taxis for small movements, minivans for families and small groups, larger vehicles for full guest parties. A single departure for a large wedding is often split across several vehicles leaving from different pickup points at staggered times.
weddings.priceNote: No wedding transfer price is published. The page states that vehicle combination and cost are confirmed after the planner supplies guest numbers and pickup locations.

faqs.q: Can you arrange wedding transportation for guests in Crete?
faqs.a: Yes. Wedding guest transportation can be organised for airport arrivals, hotel transfers, transport to and from the wedding venue and other requirements during the wedding stay.

faqs.q: Can you provide airport transfers from Heraklion and Chania?
faqs.a: Yes. Private and group transfers can be arranged from both Heraklion International Airport and Chania International Airport to Rethymno, and back again for departures.

faqs.q: Can you organise transportation between hotels and wedding venues?
faqs.a: Yes. Transport can be coordinated between hotels, villas and wedding venues according to the wedding schedule and the number of guests, within the Rethymno region.

faqs.q: Which areas of Crete do you cover for wedding transfers?
faqs.a: Rethymno city and the wider Rethymno region, including transfers to and from Chania Airport, Chania City, Heraklion Airport and Heraklion City. Journeys that start and end within Chania, Heraklion or Lassithi are not covered.

faqs.q: Do you work with wedding planners?
faqs.a: Yes. Way to Crete works directly with wedding planners and destination wedding organisers who need a local transportation and tour partner in Crete.

faqs.q: Can you organise excursions for wedding guests?
faqs.a: Yes. Private tours and excursions can be arranged for wedding guests during their stay, including cultural, gastronomic and nature experiences, departing from Rethymno.

faqs.q: Can you create a customised itinerary for a wedding group?
faqs.a: Yes. Private transportation and tours can be adapted to the group's schedule, interests, accommodation locations and overall wedding itinerary.

notes: Existing route distances and durations are road estimates. Airport and city transfers between Chania or Heraklion and Rethymno use the published fixed passenger bands in both directions. Other regional routes retain their distance-based estimates.
